//: Jest unit tests type-check under their OWN program, separate from the app tsconfig. Next.js 16's generated `.next/types` route files (included by the root tsconfig for typed-route safety) collide with @types/jest's global `it`/`test`/`describe`, making them non-callable (TS2348) whenever both live in one program. Keeping .next types out of this config resolves it. Run via `npm run tsc:jest`.
//exclude: MUST declare an explicit `exclude`: `extends` inherits the root config's `exclude` (which lists `tests/jest`) when this file omits its own, so the inherited `../../tests/jest` cancels our `include` and NO test file is type-checked — `tsc:jest` silently becomes a 1-file no-op, and editors/ESLint treat every test as 'not in any project'.
//paths: No `baseUrl` (deprecated, gone in TS 7.0) — `paths` resolve relative to THIS config's dir, so `@/*` maps to the repo root two levels up (`../../*`).
